_readme: RophysJpeg website content map. Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/build.py
photos{}: every image used by the site, keyed by id. 'source' = layout crop from the archive (local_image); 'source_original' = larger published copy (local_original) when one was saved.
pages[]: gallery order is the order of the 'photos' list. Listing order is the order of 'items'.
alt: the archive recorded no alt text for gallery photos; the build falls back to '<project title> - photograph N of M'. Add real descriptions here when you can.

site._listing_layout_options: masonry = original Format behaviour (shortest-column stacking); rows = strict two-column rows, top-aligned; grid = uniform 3-column cards with visible titles

meta.og_description: About Rophy Luberisse Altilus (ROPHYSJPEG), a Haitian-American sports photographer and media producer based in South Florida, available worldwide.

intro: I’m a Haitian-American multimedia producer and creative with roots in athletics and a passion for visual storytelling. Based in South Florida, available worldwide.

items.label: views on work I’m credited on

story.heading: From the field to the sideline
paragraphs: Sports have always been home for me. I played through college, and that time on the field shapes how I work today: I know how a game moves, where the big moments happen, and when to give players their space.

Now I’m behind the camera, capturing that same energy for the people and brands who live it. That has meant filming pitchside and in the locker rooms for Concacaf at the Gold Cup, photographing Sergio Agüero for Manchester City and PUMA, covering the FIFA World Cup 2026, and documenting community football in Jamaica.
Whether it’s a single shoot or ongoing content, I bring an athlete’s work ethic and a storyteller’s eye to every project.

services.heading: Photo, video and social, all in one

process.heading: Simple from first message to final files

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Tell me about the project, your audience and what a win looks like for you.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: We lock in dates, locations, shot lists and deliverables so the day runs smoothly.

steps.title: Capture & deliver
steps.text: I shoot, edit and deliver content that’s ready to post, on the timeline we agreed.

cta.heading: Have a project in mind? Let’s talk.
cta.text: Athletes, brands, clubs and agencies: tell me what you’re planning and we’ll build the right approach together.
